Moai Andesite Statue Structure

Мод adds Moai Andesite Statue to Minecraft, generated within the Forest biomes, bringing a better ambiance to the vanilla game

Moairium © - 2025

Notas📝 (Notes)

  • Moai Andesite Statue is compatible with versions 1.20 to 26.1.2🏷️
  • Moai Andesite Statue adds new (structures) to world generation🌐
  • Moai Andesite Statue is compatible with any generation Mod in the World
  • No it is necessary to unzip the downloaded file 🗂️

Generation🌐 (Generacion)

If you want to locate it by commands use: /locate structure moairium:andesite_moai_statue
